verdict.rationale: Alma is an immigration law firm with a technology-enabled case-management system for companies, so user-configurable event-triggered automation is a conceivable capability. However, the evidence documents no user-defined rules, triggers or automated actions. The only nearby claim is that the system "flags risk early", which is vendor-run case monitoring rather than rules a user defines, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
